visible_text: マイクと画面の音を聞いています
決まったことを待っています...
やることを待っています...
まだ発話がありません。
この会議について聞く
AI が見ている資料 ― まだありません

answers.q1: Partially. A status line says it is listening to the mic and screen audio, so the audio source is clear, but the meeting itself is only labeled '01:54 の会議' (a timestamp, not a real title), and there is no calendar name, participant list, or app/platform indicator, so which specific meeting this is stays unclear.
answers.q2: Yes, this is explicit: the bottom bar reads 'AI が見ている資料 ― まだありません' (the material the AI is looking at — none yet), so it is clear no documents are currently in use.
answers.q3: Mostly one surface. The transcript panel, chat input, and 'AI is looking at' line form one continuous white card, but the dark pill-shaped control bar at the very top (pause/chat/expand/more/stop) floats above the card with its own shadow, so it reads slightly like a separate overlaid toolbar rather than part of the same sheet.
answers.q4: The recording status ('録音中 00:02') and the live meeting timer/title ('01:54 の会議') at top-left, since they anchor that this is an active, ongoing recording — the transcript and summary panels are secondary because they are still empty.
answers.q5: The meeting title is just an elapsed-time stamp rather than a real name, so it does not actually identify the meeting. The four bottom-right action buttons (リアルタイム要約/質問する/決定事項/アクション) appear disabled with no visible reason why. Three empty 'waiting...' placeholders (決まったこと, やること, and the transcript box) repeat the same idle message, which is expected this early but leaves the panel feeling sparse.

weaknesses.what: The only meeting identifier is '01:54 の会議', a generic elapsed-time label with no calendar title, participant names, or source app shown.
weaknesses.fix: Pull the real event title (or app/platform name) from the calendar or meeting source and show that instead of a timestamp-based placeholder.

weaknesses.what: The floating dark capsule toolbar at the top sits outside and above the white card's rounded edge, visually reading as a separate overlay window rather than part of the same surface.
weaknesses.fix: Dock the control bar as a header row inside the same card frame instead of a detached floating pill.

weaknesses.what: The right-hand panel is almost entirely empty placeholder text plus four grayed-out buttons, making that half of the screen feel underused at a glance.
weaknesses.fix: Combine the idle states into a single lighter-weight message, or use the space for a short onboarding hint instead of near-empty duplicated placeholders.
